Then maximize the minimum validation optimal-completion rate across all cohorts and their21+ subsets, followed by mean optimal rate, success cost ratio, validation loss and deterministic run/checkpoint names. Freeze before generating any new test pair. Earlier efficiency tests are development history and excluded from fresh generation.

current_bank.scope: Whole decisions only. Every retained parent has all legal successors; held-out continuations are counted, never pruned or silently labelled as covered.
current_bank.cost_scope: First uphill choice per allowed training-root trajectory, including nonoptimal successes; whole cycle members retained. Exact unit-exchange prefix identity checked. Protected complete decisions rejected before branch expansion; no held test trajectory is mined.

merged_bank.scope: Aggregate old and current-policy cycle seeds, preserving all prior roots; recompute complete branches and exact continuations under the same protected training information.
